population_rule: risk_class = SUSPECT (R1), excluding xyp-XY67a (already CONFIRMED WRONG in ATTR-0 §3)
evidence_classes_used: Bulbapedia per-card Release information sections that explicitly distinguish the suffixed printing from the base printing
PkmnCards per-print card pages carrying an exact-print illustrator credit and scan
sources_rejected_as_non_independent: limitlesstcg.com — reproduces the same base-illustrator defect as TCGdex on at least GEN/28a, AOR/75a and FCO/111a; treated as a derived feed, not corroboration
artifact_hash_note: SHA-256 over the LF-normalised UTF-8 bytes of the committed CSV. docs/attr-0-evidence/*.csv is pinned to eol=lf in .gitattributes, so the working-tree bytes match on every platform.
interpretation_limit: This gate verifies the ILLUSTRATOR CREDIT on each exact printing. It does not verify artist_id, aliases, or any Illustrated Vault resolution behaviour, and it performs no repair. CAT-0 F-15 remains open and still blocks per-row repair.
